bibliographic.title: Two Spirits At Sea
bibliographic.author: Norbez Jones (call me Bez)
bibliographic.description:
After "The Incident", friends Humphrey & Jayden have passed away.  In the afterlife, they're drifting on a never-ending sea, on a ship that doesn't have a destination.  One day, they have the dialogue archived in this game.

__________

This was made for Shufflecomp 2024 & Seedcomp 2025, and features voice acting by James Fagan & Ryan Gaiser.  I had been wanting to make a Seedcomp game with this seed, but wasn't sure what to make--that is, until I saw the release of the Public Domain Image Archive.  Browsing the archive, I was struck with inspiration, and after looking at a few other Seedcomp seeds, this game was brought to life.

I'm curious what people will think of this project.  If you have a moment, I would love to hear your thoughts in the comments.

-- Bez

P.S. This is the 1st of 3 games I will be releasing for Shufflecomp.  Please look forward to the other two!  I'll also be releasing at least one more game for Seedcomp.

___________

Seedcomp seeds used:
  • A Dismal Vessel
  • Story B/They Crawl
  • Moans & Tones (track 02)

Shufflecomp song:
  • Acid Food by Mogwai
